scope: First held-action ridge repair router trained on six EPIC Ego H3 windows
summary: The router preserved the declared capability non-regression contract and achieved 0.0479 mean regret, but exact held-action recipe selection was only 1/6, below the 0.5 release gate.
evidence: Thirty domain-matched repair rows cover two windows, three actions, and five bounded recipes.
Held-action selection accuracy is 0.1667, mean regret is 0.047879, and selected non-regression rate is 1.0.
The manifest status is rejected and its checkpoint is not used for formal demo routing.
lessons: Low regret is not a substitute for reliable recipe identity when a post-processing router can select visibly different support widths.
limitations: Only one public kitchen clip, one seed, two windows, and three commands are available.
next_actions: Sweep ridge alpha without changing gates, then audit whether the objective incorrectly rewards background-damaging wide repairs.
